verses.text: Nineveh, an attacker is coming against you! Guard the fortress! Watch the road! Get ready for battle! Gather all your strength!
The LORD will bring back the glory of Jacob, like the glory of Israel, even though destroyers have stripped them bare and ruined their vines.
The shields of the soldiers are red. The warriors are dressed in scarlet. The metal on the chariots flashes on the day they are prepared, and the spears of pine are waved in the air.
The chariots race wildly through the streets. They rush back and forth through the squares. They look like flaming torches. They dart around like lightning.
The king calls for his best troops, but they stumble on their way. They rush to the city wall, and the protective shield is set in place.
The river gates are thrown open, and the palace collapses.
It has been decided: the city will be stripped and carried away. Its female slaves moan like doves and beat their breasts.
Nineveh has been like a pool of water since long ago, but now its people are running away. "Stop! Stop!" others cry, but no one turns back.
Take the silver! Take the gold! There is no end to its treasure, riches of every kind of precious thing.
She is empty, stripped, and ruined! Hearts melt in fear, and knees knock together. Bodies shake, and every face turns pale.
Where now is the lions' den, the place where the young lions were fed? The lion and lioness and their cubs used to go there, and no one frightened them.
The lion killed enough for his cubs and strangled prey for his mates. He filled his caves with what he killed and his dens with prey.

"I am against you," says the LORD of Armies. "I will burn up your chariots in smoke, and the sword will kill your young lions. I will leave you no prey on the earth. The voices of your messengers will never be heard again."
